topic: Pick one language for the team to standardize backend services on

scenario.topic: Pick one language for the team to standardize backend services on
scenario.opening_question: Which backend language balances developer productivity and long-term maintainability best for our team?

options.name: Go with Gin Framework
options.upside: Produces highly performant services with simple concurrency
options.tradeoff: Smaller ecosystem means fewer libraries and integrations
options.concern: Some team members may find Go's error handling verbose

options.name: Node.js with Express
options.upside: Huge ecosystem and fast development with JavaScript familiarity
options.tradeoff: Single-threaded nature can limit CPU-bound task performance
options.concern: Callback-heavy code can lead to maintainability issues
options.best_for: rapid development and wide third-party support

options.name: Python with Django
options.upside: Batteries-included framework with excellent developer productivity
options.tradeoff: Slower runtime performance compared to compiled languages
options.concern: May require more resources to scale under heavy load
options.best_for: quick feature development and rich built-in tools

options.name: Java with Spring Boot
options.upside: Robust, scalable, and widely adopted in enterprise environments
options.tradeoff: Longer development time and more boilerplate code
options.concern: Steeper learning curve may slow onboarding of new developers

shared_context: The team has exactly 5 backend developers
The project timeline is 12 months with a fixed budget
The goal is to standardize backend services for scalability and ease of onboarding
